core: Mitochondrial respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
name: Oxidative phosphorylation signature with respiratory chain and chemiosmotic ATP coupling
rationale: All members cover mitochondrial electron transport (complex III to IV) coupled to ATP synthesis; unlike its closest neighbour it also carries the oxidative phosphorylation gene signature, and unlike others it lacks respiratory complex assembly and mitochondrial translation.

core: Mitochondrial electron transport coupled to ATP synthesis
qualifier: ubiquinol-to-oxygen electron flow only, no gene signature or complex assembly
name: Ubiquinol-to-oxygen respiratory electron flow coupled to ATP formation
rationale: Members are only the electron-transfer steps from ubiquinol via cytochrome c to oxygen plus chemiosmotic ATP formation, without the oxidative phosphorylation gene signature of its superset neighbour or the complex assembly content of others.

core: Mitochondrial transcription and translation
name: Mitochondrial transcription, translation and mitoribosome quality control
rationale: All members are steps of mitochondrial gene expression (transcription initiation/termination and its regulation, translation initiation/elongation/termination) plus mitoribosome-associated quality control, without the mtDNA repair and ribosome assembly of its superset neighbour or the RNA/tRNA processing of others.

core: Mitochondrial transcription and translation
name: Mitochondrial DNA maintenance, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mitochondrial transcription and translation and additionally mtDNA repair, regulation of mtDNA metabolism and small mitoribosome subunit assembly, which distinguish it from the pure gene-expression theme and from RNA-processing or replication neighbours.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and dopaminergic neuron differentiation
qualifier: forebrain patterning and neural stem cell maintenance
name: Forebrain patterning, neural stem cell maintenance and dopaminergic neurogenesis
rationale: Members share neural progenitor proliferation/division and midbrain dopaminergic differentiation, and unlike neighbours include forebrain morphogenesis and dorsal/ventral patterning, neuronal stem cell maintenance and regulation of asymmetric division.

core: Neuroblast division and midbrain dopaminergic neurogenesis
qualifier: radial glia differentiation and asymmetric neuroblast division
name: Radial glia, asymmetric neuroblast division and midbrain dopaminergic neurogenesis
rationale: Members share neural progenitor division and dopaminergic neuron differentiation, and are distinguished from the forebrain-patterning sibling by forebrain radial glial and Bergmann glial differentiation, asymmetric neuroblast division and neuron maturation.

core: Neuronal migration and cortical lamination
name: Tangential interneuron migration and cortical layer formation
rationale: All seven members concern neuronal migration (GABAergic interneuron and olfactory bulb precursor tangential migration, radial glia guided migration) and cortical layering/regionalization, without the axon tract, neuron-type commitment and migration-regulation content of its superset neighbours.

core: Cortical neuron migration and lamination
name: Cortical migration, lamination and commissural/corticospinal tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover forebrain neuron migration and cortical layering and, unlike its neighbours, also corpus callosum, anterior commissure and corticospinal tract morphogenesis plus radial glial differentiation.

core: Forebrain neuron migration and cortical lamination
name: Forebrain neuron specification, regulated migration and cortical lamination
rationale: Members share cortical migration and layering and add forebrain neuron-type commitment, pyramidal neuron development, thalamus development and positive/negative regulation of neuron migration, while lacking the axon-tract morphogenesis of its superset neighbour.

core: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
name: Neutrophil degranulation and oxidative antibacterial and antifungal killing
rationale: All members concern neutrophil degranulation, respiratory burst/ROS regulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, without the tissue macrophage programme and neutrophil-activation restraint of its superset neighbour or the chemotaxis/receptor content of others.

core: Phagocyte oxidative burst, degranulation and microbial killing
name: Neutrophil and macrophage oxidative burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members share neutrophil degranulation, respiratory burst and antibacterial/antifungal killing, and uniquely add the resident macrophage/CYBB phagocyte module, negative regulation of neutrophil activation and mucus secretion.

core: NOD1/2 signaling to JNK/p38
qualifier: muramyl dipeptide sensing, kinase regulation without TNF
name: NOD1/2 muramyl dipeptide sensing and JNK/p38 kinase regulation
rationale: Members combine NOD1/NOD2 peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing with TAK1-driven activation and negative regulation of JNK and p38, lacking the TNF-pathway and broader stress-kinase content of its superset neighbour and the NF-kB/TLR content of others.

core: NOD1/2 signaling to stress kinases
name: NOD1/2-TAK1 stress kinase signaling with TNF-pathway potentiation
rationale: Members share NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 control, and are distinguished by positive regulation of TNF-mediated signaling, broader stress-activated kinase regulation and cellular response to external stimulus.

core: NOD1/NOD2 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing with K63 ubiquitination and inflammasome signaling
rationale: All members concern NOD-like receptor responses to peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide, and unlike its subset neighbour include the NOD1/2 pathway proper, inflammasome receptors and positive regulation of K63-linked ubiquitination.

core: NOD1/NOD2 responses to peptidoglycan
qualifier: regulation of NOD signaling by muramyl dipeptide
name: NOD1/NOD2 regulation in antibacterial muramyl dipeptide response
rationale: The six members are NOD1/NOD2 signaling and its regulation in the antibacterial response to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide, lacking the inflammasome, K63 ubiquitination and downstream TAK1/MAPK content of its neighbours.

core: NRF2 and HIF transcriptional stress programs
qualifier: NRF2 turnover and HIF prolyl-hydroxylation oxygen sensing
name: NRF2 turnover and target genes with HIF oxygen sensing
rationale: Members cover NRF2 expression, GSK3B/BTRC-mediated degradation and target-gene programs plus HIF prolyl hydroxylation and hypoxia signaling, without the glycolysis, BACH1 and pentose phosphate content of its superset neighbour.

core: NRF2 and HIF transcriptional stress programs
name: NRF2-BACH1 and HIF programs with glycolytic and pentose phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members share NRF2 target programs and HIF hypoxia signaling, and uniquely add BACH1 regulation, the glycolysis gene signature and regulation of the pentose phosphate shunt.

core: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate transport
name: Mitotic nuclear pore disassembly, reformation and inositol phosphate traffic
rationale: All members concern the nuclear pore complex (mitotic disassembly, postmitotic reassembly, TPR defect) and transport through it of inositol phosphates and Rev, without the pore positioning, gene tethering and HIV RNA export of its superset neighbour.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
qualifier: pore positioning, peripheral gene tethering, Rev-mediated RNA export
name: Nuclear pore positioning, gene tethering and Rev-mediated nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members share nuclear pore assembly/disassembly and inositol phosphate transport, and uniquely add nuclear pore localization, tethering of transcribed genes at the nuclear periphery and Rev-mediated HIV RNA export.

core: Osmotic stress response and epithelial NaCl transport
qualifier: osmosensing of hypo- and hypertonicity, no hormonal control
name: Hypo- and hypertonic osmosensing with epithelial NaCl transport
rationale: The five members are osmosensory signaling, cellular hyper- and hypotonic responses, renal sodium and transepithelial chloride transport, lacking the aldosterone, renin-angiotensin and sodium-import regulation of its superset neighbour.

core: Renal sodium handling and osmotic stress response
name: Aldosterone- and renin-angiotensin-regulated renal sodium handling and osmotic stress
rationale: Members share osmotic/salt stress responses and renal Na/Cl transport, and are distinguished by cellular response to aldosterone, renin-angiotensin blood-pressure regulation, control of sodium import and intracellular water homeostasis.

core: Osteoclast development and bone resorption
qualifier: balanced positive and negative regulation, no DAP12 or macrophage fusion
name: Positive and negative control of osteoclastogenesis and bone remodeling
rationale: All six members regulate osteoclast proliferation, differentiation, fusion and bone resorption/remodeling in both directions, lacking the DAP12 signaling and macrophage fusion/syncytium members of its superset neighbour.

core: Osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption
qualifier: DAP12 signaling and macrophage syncytium formation
name: DAP12-linked macrophage fusion into osteoclast syncytia and bone resorption
rationale: Members share osteoclast differentiation, proliferation and bone resorption, and uniquely add DAP12 signaling, regulation of macrophage fusion and plasma membrane fusion/syncytium formation.

core: Peroxisomal fatty acid metabolism
qualifier: omega-oxidation, NAD(P) cofactor supply and peroxisome fission
name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism with omega-oxidation, NAD(P) supply and fission
rationale: Members span peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation, VLCFA elongation and ether lipid synthesis, and beyond its subset neighbour add fatty acid omega-oxidation (CYP2U1), NAD transport and NADP+ synthesis, malonyl/succinyl-CoA metabolism and peroxisome fission.

core: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and elongation
qualifier: VLCFA and phytanate oxidation with plasmalogen synthesis
name: Peroxisomal VLCFA and phytanate oxidation, elongation and plasmalogen synthesis
rationale: All members are peroxisomal lipid pathways (very-long-chain and pristanoyl beta-oxidation, phytanate alpha-oxidation, VLCFA/PUFA elongation, plasmalogen and wax synthesis), without the omega-oxidation, NAD(P) cofactor and fission content of its superset neighbour or the protein import of others.
